infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Roadclaim records the route, distance and speed of your drives. Your route stays on your phone.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Roadclaim starts recording automatically when you drive, without you touching your phone. Your route stays on your phone.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: Roadclaim starts recording automatically when you drive, without you touching your phone. Your route stays on your phone.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: Roadclaim uses motion activity to notice when you start and stop driving, so recording begins on its own.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Roadclaim saves your drive cards and car mods to your photos.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Pick a photo of your car to create AI mods of it.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Take a photo of your car to create AI mods of it.
